logic_group.name: libplist auto-detect format dispatcher
logic_group.description: The plist_from_memory function implements a format auto-detection heuristic that inspects the first bytes of input to route parsing to one of four format-specific parsers. It first checks for the "bplist00" magic via plist_is_binary (8-byte memcmp), then skips whitespace and inspects the first non-whitespace character: '<' routes to XML, '[' to JSON, '(' to OpenStep, and '{' triggers an ambiguity resolution loop that scans for a ':' after a quoted key to distinguish JSON from OpenStep. Each branch dispatches to the corresponding internal parser state machine — parse_bin_node_at_index for binary plists (recursive node tree builder with offset table lookups), node_from_xml for XML (recursive tag parser), jsmn_parse for JSON (token-based state machine), and node_from_openstep (recursive descent parser). This single entry point exercises format detection edge cases (boundary conditions in whitespace skipping, escape handling in the JSON/OpenStep disambiguator) plus all four parser cores, making it uniquely valuable compared to the existing per-format fuzzers.
